title: High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method
snippet: Tabulated steady-state benchmark solutions for the lid-driven cavity: velocity profiles along the centerlines and vortex-center locations for Re = 100 to 10000.

title: Benchmark spectral results on the lid-driven cavity flow
snippet: Spectral-accuracy reference data for the two-dimensional lid-driven cavity, including streamfunction extrema and secondary-vortex intensities at moderate Reynolds numbers.

title: Hopf bifurcation of the unsteady regularized driven cavity flow
snippet: Locates the first Hopf bifurcation of the driven cavity and characterizes the transition from steady to periodic flow as the Reynolds number increases.
